//: Template for appsettings.Local.json — copy this file to that name and fill in your keys.
The real file is gitignored; this one is committed so the shape is documented.
Keys are never put in appsettings.json or appsettings.Development.json: neither is
ignored, so a key placed in the obvious file goes into the repository with it.

Ingestion.//Sports: Leagues to poll. Narrow this to what is in season — an out-of-season league costs credits and quotes nothing.
//Espn: The stats source (schedules, scores, box scores). It ships off here, as everywhere else.
ESPN's endpoints are unofficial and undocumented. ESPN's terms of use license its
services for personal, non-commercial use and prohibit automated access. Turning this on
is your decision; use it only to keep data in your own local database, never to host,
redistribute or sell it. The MLB Stats API comes on with it.
Set Enabled to true to opt in, then restart.
//TheOddsApi: https://the-odds-api.com — free tier is 500 credits a month.
A call bills markets x regions, so the Markets list below is the main cost control.
The /sports endpoint is free, which is what the platform uses to verify a key.

TheOddsApi.//MarketsBySport: A league's own list overrides Markets. NFL over/unders cost one more credit a scan: three, not two.

Backfill.//Since: Fixed date rather than a rolling day count, so the walk finishes and stays finished.
